name: ai-promo-video
description: Create polished AI-directed promo videos from real product captures and licensed free media with a headless pipeline.

interface.shortDescription: AI-directed product capture and motion design
interface.longDescription: Search a broad motion-component vocabulary plus local folders, Openverse, Wikimedia Commons, and optional free-key Pexels; compare and analyze licensed free music without a default track; record real products with Playwright; combine reusable and custom Revideo or Three.js motion in one editable composition; render changed ranges, splice revisions, and inspect the final video without a graphical editor or bundled model.
defaultPrompt: Create a 30-second promo for my SaaS.
Capture my product and render a polished launch video.
Review this SaaS promo and improve its motion design.
